name: PSSHI_PiFilter
rationale: The previous best design (PSSHI_LCFilter) failed on S4 because of a conflict between the storage capacitor size: a larger C1 was needed to suppress ripple (vpp), but this made the time constant (tau = RL*C) too long for the output to settle (dv) within 0.8s. By introducing a Pi-filter (C2-L2-C1) at the output of the rectifier, we can achieve superior ripple suppression with a smaller total capacitance. This reduces the settling time for the light-load S4 condition while maintaining low ripple for the heavy-load S6 condition.
